first_reader_said: LUK 3:25: Both records are Amos, son of Naum and father of Mattathias, at the same place in Luke's genealogy.

why: Both records identify the Amos of LUK 3:25 as son of Naum and father of Mattathias, occupying the same place in Luke’s genealogy. Keep B because its verse attribution is correct: MAT 1:10 names Amon, son of Manasses and father of Josias, and is wrongly attached to A.
